definition: to put something down somewhere for a while
description: Inside a warm, old-fashioned bar. A man with short brown hair and a cream linen shirt lifts a bulldog in a striped knitted jumper from the bar edge and sets it down carefully on a round wooden bar stool, where it stands calmly. He lets go, steps back and gestures towards the dog. A newspaper and a set of keys lie on the marble counter beside a brass rail. Shelves of bottles glow behind the bar, a bartender works in the background, and other customers talk further along.

de.answer: Er stellt den Hund auf den Hocker.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está poniendo al perro en el taburete.
